main_text.l: strari posse. Placuit aduersariis mustea cauillatio;
in qua nunc vna plærique vulgo omnem
suâ sophisticen, atqį dialecticen ita collocarunt, vt
putent ad nos debellandos hoc vnum satis
esse, si diserta de singulis fidei nostræ capitibus
Scripturæ loca flagitentur; neque dubitent, quin
de nobis nullo negotio sit triumphaturus.

page.notes: The woodcut initial N is joined to "UPER" as "VPER"; reading of "nouiriį" and "mustea" is uncertain; the catchword "quiŧ" at the foot right is partly illegible and marked as a catchword candidate. Printed "quil" read as "quiŧ" with [?] advised.
